values.EXPERIMENT_OS_ISSUE_COMMAND: {"command_id":"perpv1-closeout-gap-1","action":"OPEN_MANUAL","actor":"claude-code","actor_role":"RESEARCH_LAB","schema_version":1,"payload":{"title":"Experiment OS cannot record an experiment that ran and finished outside it","problem_statement":"PERP-V1 ran a full probe lifecycle unregistered - pre-registration, tape collector, scorer, three arm verdicts - and reached a conclusion. Registering while it ran would have redeployed the worker for a probe that creates no strategy tag and cannot trade, so it never was. Correct at the time; the cost appeared at the end. XOS cannot record the one true thing about it: it happened and it is over. Its documents are the only durable lifecycle record, which is the fragmentation XOS exists to prevent. THE GAP IS GENERAL: any experiment that runs outside and finishes hits it. Neither existing path works. REGISTER_PACKAGE alone would leave a closed, failed experiment as an ACTIVE PROBE with open never-evaluated gates - Control Tower showing a dead experiment as live research, worse than documents-only. import_legacy_experiment is for PRE-cutover history and would mark post-cutover work grandfathered, which Legacy Migration is told never to do (its own rule: a gap that is really new work must be native). A proposed fix is up as PR #314 (CLOSE_OUT_RETROSPECTIVE: register, record non-PASS verdicts, retire, atomically; refuses PASS, refuses any target but RETIRED, refuses an experiment holding deployments). Filed UNCLASSIFIED deliberately: issue_policy says touching Experiment OS code is NOT PLATFORM, so routing to Platform Change Review is the owner's call, not the reporter's.
